org.name: SageBio
org.details: Open Science and Open Source. Creator of Synapse.org, NIH-listed generalist repository for biomedical data managing 2+PB data. Enabler of DREAM biomedical challenges

latest.raw: The current rules require us to cite the Hackathon dataset using the exact reference on the Synapse page. I checked syn76251147 and its sole wiki page (642892), but I cannot find a formatted dataset citation or DOI. Could the organizers please provide the exact reference text that Track 2 reports should use? I will insert it verbatim before submission. Thank you.

latest.raw: Thank you for flagging this and to clarify one thing: the dataset citation requirement only applies if you later publish something using this data (a paper, preprint, conference abstract, etc.) — it's not something you need to include in your Track 2 report submission itself for now.
